set.body:
Acceptance:
- Required epic children close with exact source/provider and numerical/performance evidence. Confirm family boundaries, original-model ML normalization, rank/identification/approximation receipts and unchanged legacy fit contracts.
- Runnable Gaussian/LWU and continuous Cascade34 examples show shape, trial amplitudes, condition means, units, diagnostics and streaming; half-cosine examples explicitly state admitted subfamily/cells or unsupported cases.
- Documentation states actual measured throughput/memory, supported observation geometry/pulses, local coverage and uncertainty limits. Expected-information, state approximations and coefficient interpolation remain opt-in unadmitted unless separately qualified.
- All affected JVM+JS suites and laws/scenarios pass; run compileAll/testAll on exact integrated provider revisions. Record any unrelated gate failure distinctly; pending is not passing.
- Inspect a real downstream consumer and exported result axes. Adaptive outputs do not expose an invalid global linear readout or invented OLS t/F/df.
Performance: release requires PHRF-15 evidence and explicit disposition of every goal. No production-ready label based only on dense Python probes.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-16: Integrate and release qualified ProfileHrf with Cascade34
